title: How to Stop Rejections From Clearly Qualified Jobs
description:
Getting rejected from a job you know you were completely qualified for is incredibly disheartening. So here’s what to do. Use the job description to guide edits to your resume. You know you can do the work but the company is looking for specific skills so if you can show that on your resume you’ll have a better chance of getting an intervirew. #resume #resumetips #resumeediting #resumetok #jobdescription #jobseeker #jobseekers
